newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil poultry output up, mkt oversupplied-Caspian.
newsitem.headline: Brazil poultry output up, mkt oversupplied-Caspian.

text.p: Poultry output in Brazil rose 6.9 percent in the first five months versus the same period last year and the local market is oversupplied despite higher exports, Caspian Securities said.
Exports rose 20.6 percent in the January-May period but domestic prices are still depressed as consumption still lags supply, Caspian analyst Lilyanna Yang said in a report.
"After a flat market in 1996, lower corn prices stimulated independent producers to increase production, depressing prices for commodity chicken," she wrote.

But major players in Brazil's food sector -- Sadia, Perdigao and Ceval -- are raising market shares and consolidating their leading positions by focusing on speciality meats and pre-prepared meals, she said.
